verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's schedule and escalation-policy docs indicate coverage rules exist (pagerduty-docs-12, pagerduty-docs-7), and the AI 'Shift Agent' explicitly automates shift-swap/coverage requests ('monitors calendars, detects potential conflicts, identifies qualified replacements, and coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention') (pagerduty-docs-58). Community evidence confirms manual calendar overrides exist in the product but are described as 'clunky' (pagerduty-comm-4), suggesting the self-service experience has real friction rather than being seamless. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of an on-call engineer self-service override/swap UI flow, confirmation that no admin intervention is ever required, and independent hands-on validation that the process works smoothly.
